rows.en:
What do they have that I'm missing...?
What could it be...?
rows.notes: aitsu = the Nyan-Nyan mascot (gender unknown): singular 'they'.

rows.en:
Thought I'd figure it out if I danced with
a clear mind, but reality ain't that easy.

(I doubt Nyan-Nyan's mascot character
image is anything that deep...)
But I can't lose to 'em... No, I don't WANT to lose!

First I gotta drill it into my body, or it's all talk!
Push myself to the absolute limit!
That's the only shortcut.

G-Good luck, Luis-san...
I think I'll be heading home now......
You're joining me! And you're giving it your all too!!

You might get asked to do a commercial too,
so it can't hurt to practice, right?
What......
Whaaaaaaaaat!!

...All right! I see it! I see it! A ray of light!!
You've got pretty good sense yourself, huh?
R-Really...?

That timing, that angle... don't you forget 'em.
I felt some real passion there... Thanks.
See ya.
Oh, see you later then...

(Phew... after dancing a hundred sets,
I'm completely wiped out...)
Oops, forgot to tell you.

Your face on the 'Yummy-nyan'...
was pretty good.
...Th-Thank you very much.

(I never thought I'd end up being made
to practice the Nyan-Nyan Dance...)

(I'm sure practicing the Nyan-Nyan Dance
will never come in handy in my life, though...)

(Taking a different way home like this
isn't bad once in a while...)

(Wait, huh? Isn't that Luis-san?
What on earth is he doing here?)

Hm? Well, if it isn't Fresh Girl.
What on earth are you doing here?

Ahh, I'm getting nervous...
...All right! Here goes, Fresh Girl!

(I doubt Nyan-Nyan's mascot character
image is anything that deep...)

G-Good luck, Luis-san...
I think I'll be heading home now......

(Phew... after dancing a hundred sets,
I'm completely wiped out...)

(I never thought I'd end up being made
to practice the Nyan-Nyan Dance...)

(Don't tell me Luis-san is practicing
the Nyan-Nyan Dance again today...)
(Oh, he is...)

Just a little more... Just a little more,
and I'll surpass 'em...!
All right! Another hundred sets!!

Gorgeous! Delicious! Deculture!
Gorgeous......
(Good luck, Luis-san...!)

(I don't want sore muscles again, so I'll
slip away without saying anything...)

(I don't want sore muscles again, so I'll
slip away without saying anything...)

(Wandering around Deep Akihabara like this
isn't half bad...)

(Wait, huh? It's Luis-san.
What on earth is he doing?)

I was just wandering around with nothing to do.
What are you up to, Luis-san?

I can't say it too loud, but!
I'm about to go to a place
called a maid cafe!!
(You're plenty loud already, Luis-san...)
(Wait, a maid cafe!?)
Why would you want to go to a maid cafe...?

I only heard about it in passing, but...
it's some kinda seriously extreme spot, right?

Luis-san...
Do you know what a maid cafe is?

How would I know? I've never been to one.
An extreme cafe... even I can't imagine it.

(So he's going without knowing a thing.
Maybe I'd better explain it to him...)

Luis-san,
to put it simply, a maid cafe is...
Be quiet, Fresh Boy.
rows.notes: 'Be quiet' is English in the Japanese.

rows.en: Huh!

If someone tells you about it, half the
thrill and excitement's gone, ain't it!!

I wanna feel the thrill of going in
with zero prior knowledge!

(Well, but...
whether a maid cafe has any thrills...)

Man, this Deep Akihabara place is
brimming with the fever of all kinds of people.
W-Well, maybe so...

I've never felt fever like this before...
Honestly, I'm shaking......

I can't lose either! I'll show 'em my passion!
In a way, this place is a battlefield too...
I'm burning up!!
rows.notes: moeru (burn) puns on moe in the next row.

rows.en:
(Luis-san...
around here, 'burning' just sounds
like you're saying 'moe'......)
rows.notes: Pun moeru (to burn) / moeru (moe, otaku affection); kept the word 'moe'.

rows.en: Well, I'm off to the maid cafe. See ya!

Wait for me, maid cafe!
EXTREEEEEEEEME!!!
Ah, Luis-san...
(Hmmm...)

(Was it really okay not to tell Luis-san
what a maid cafe is?)
(I hope he doesn't cause the shop any trouble...)

(Wandering around Deep Akihabara like this
isn't half bad...)

(Wait, huh? Isn't that Luis-san?
What on earth is he doing?)

(So he's going without knowing a thing.
Maybe I'd better explain it to him...)
Be quiet, Fresh Girl.
rows.notes: 'Be quiet' is English in the Japanese.

rows.en:
(Was it really okay not to tell Luis-san
what a maid cafe is?)

(Come to think of it, did Luis-san ever
actually go to the maid cafe?)

(The way he was going, he probably did...
but if he's become a regular or something,
I wouldn't like that either...)

(Oh, it's Luis-san.
Looks like he's arguing about something
in front of the maid cafe...)
(Oh, he stormed off somewhere.)

(Could it be... he caused the shop so much
trouble that he got banned?)
(With Luis-san, that's entirely possible...)

(Come to think of it, did Luis-san ever
actually go to the maid cafe?)

(The way he was going, he probably did...
but if he's become a regular or something,
I wouldn't like that either...)
(Oh, he stormed off somewhere.)

(Could it be... he caused the shop so much
trouble that he got banned?)
(With Luis-san, that's entirely possible...)

uncertain: c08387/c08388: pun on moeru (burn, 'I'm burning up!!') and moe (otaku affection) in Deep Akihabara; kept 'moe' in the player's retort.
c08331/c08334/c08361: aitsu = the Nyan-Nyan commercial mascot, gender unknown; singular they/'em.
'maid cafe' written without the accent (Shift-JIS, no e-acute).
